'''Lothor''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] present during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. As a member of [[Clan Varad]], Lothor participated in the [[Battle for the Allusis]]. Together with [[Tiru]] and [[Kandon]], they were known collectively as [[Battle Team Royal]]. Summoned by their clan chieftain [[Mavrix Varad]] to stop a strike team from capturing the Republic cruiser [[Allusis]], they were untimely and unknowingly killed by another boarding party's drop pod.
